items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Very good friend of mine too, for many years.

ctx.x: Just sharing there. And what about, who is Sidney Wilson?

Sidney Wilson was one of the finest piano players I've ever played. He played in the Palace Theatre. For years he was great. Very good friend of mine too, for many years. He used to come out and see us, and of course he's living, I believe, last we heard he was supposed to be living in Baton Rouge. We used to, well he called us quite a bit and then later on he, you know, we'd have to call him, he couldn't use the phone or something like that, he had to have somebody else come and get the dialed numbers. But we…
And you showed me pictures of Morris Music Shops, of Morris Music School. What was that, this music school?
